meta_note: All methods are gRPC procedures exposed by PaymentService. API Gateway is the primary caller.

conventions.metadata_user_id: x-user-id: <userId> is required and extracted by RpcAuthGuard

rpc_errors.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Missing subscription/customer context or invalid business preconditions
rpc_errors.INTERNAL: Unexpected server error while calling Paystack or database operations

createCheckoutSession.description: Create a Paystack Checkout session for an authenticated user who does not already have an active Paystack subscription.

input.originUrl: string (required) — frontend origin used to build success/cancel URLs

throws.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Subscription record missing or user already has a Paystack subscription

createPortalSession.description: Create a Paystack Billing Portal session for users who already have an associated Paystack customer.

input.originUrl: string (required) — return URL after completing actions in Paysatck portal

createTrialSession.description: Start the 2-month free Pro trial. Initializes a ₦50 card-verification charge via Paystack. On charge.success the gateway webhook handler creates the future-dated subscription, encrypts and stores the authorization + email tokens, creates the SusbcriptionFreeTrials abuse-guard record, and refunds the ₦50. The trial period is 60 days (TRIAL_DURATION_DAYS). A given email address can only ever claim one trial — the guard survives account deletion.

input.originUrl: string (required) — used to build the Paystack callback URL (redirects to originUrl/dashboard)

output.checkoutSessionUrl: string — Paystack hosted payment URL; redirect the user here to capture their card

throws.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Subscription record or user details missing
throws.ALREADY_EXISTS: Trial already used for this email address (emailHash found in SusbcriptionFreeTrials)

side_effects: On charge.success (purpose: trial_card_verification): Subscription.plan set to PRO, future-dated paystackSubscriptionCode created, paystackEmailToken + paystackAuthorizationCode encrypted and stored, SusbcriptionFreeTrials row created, ₦50 refunded

cancelSubscription.description: Disable auto-renewal on the authenticated user's active Paystack subscription. The user retains Pro access until paystackCurrentPeriodEnd — the scheduler sweep handles the actual downgrade at period end. The paystackEmailToken is decrypted from storage before the Paystack disable call.

throws.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Subscription, paystackSubscriptionCode, or paystackEmailToken not found

side_effects: Paystack fires subscription.disable or subscription.not_renew webhook — gateway handler sets Subscription.status to NON_RENEWING and paystackCancelAtPeriodEnd to true

resumeSubscription.description: Re-enable auto-renewal on a previously disabled subscription. Only valid while the subscription is still within its current period (i.e. before paystackCurrentPeriodEnd). The paystackEmailToken is decrypted from storage before the Paystack enable call.

throws.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Subscription, paystackSubscriptionCode, or paystackEmailToken not found

side_effects: Paystack resumes the subscription — no webhook fired for re-enable; status change confirmed by next invoice.create event
